summary: Suzano S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting board approval of a capital increase within authorized capital by capitalizing R$14.57 million from a tax incentive reserve, with no new shares issued. The share capital rises from R$24,269,281,424.63 to R$24,283,855,078.43, split among the same 1,264,117,615 common shares. A bylaw amendment reflecting the new capital will be proposed at the next shareholders meeting. This is a routine accounting reallocation, not a special situation. No deal terms, consideration, premium, or strategic change is involved. There is no event for risk-arb or activist focus.
